bundle.text:
# 本 bundle 的 patch：把插件作为一条 Host 行插入 profile 根部。
# 行 id `opencode-quota` 同时是设置项与插件管理里的标识。
- insert:
    - id: opencode-quota

readme.text:
OpenCode 用量面板

在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，随时看清 OpenCode 的额度、花费和趋势。

安装 · 界面 · 账户形态 · 开发与原理
English: README.en.md

> [!NOTE] > 这是 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方插件，数据来自 OpenCode 官方。
侧栏卡片（浅色主题，示意数据）：用量 · 额度 · 预测 · 趋势 · 模型

OpenCode 的额度、花费和用量分散在几个接口里：Go 订阅的滚动 / 周 / 月窗口，Console 的花费与 token。这个插件把它们收进一张侧栏卡片，不用打开网页控制台，也不用自己算。

- **Go 和按量账户都能用**：有 Go 订阅时显示额度窗口；只有 Console 用量时保留花费、趋势和模型。
- **知道今天花了多少**：今日花费、请求数、tokens，以及本周 / 本月汇总。
- **看见趋势**：7 天 / 24 小时，花费 / tokens / 请求数随时切换。
- **提前知道会不会用完**：有月度额度时，按当前计费周期的花费速度外推，标出 50% / 100% 的预计日期。
- **知道钱花在哪个模型**：按花费排序的模型条形图。
- **多账户不打架**：同一组织的 Key 合并成一张卡，不同组织分开；可切换账户，花费可按服务账号筛选。
- **高度可配置**：分块显示/隐藏与排序、色条、四档阈值、趋势指标、刷新间隔都能改。
- **不打扰**：跟随 DSH 主题、中英双语、无外部 CDN，偏好只存在本机。
下面按侧栏卡片的五个分块、设置页的三个面板分别说明。截图使用固定样例数据（`acme` / `org_acme` 等账户名与组织 id 均为虚构），实际数字随账户变化。

卡片放在侧栏设置按钮上方；侧栏收起时退化为一个百分比/金额小方块，展开后按偏好顺序显示分块，默认只开「用量」和「额度重置时间」，其余在设置里随时打开。每个分块标题右侧有个箭头，点一下就把这一块收成一行（只留标题和它的关键数据，例如用量显示当日花费、额度显示本月已用、趋势显示最近一根、模型显示第一名），再点展开。卡片右上角还有收起按钮，收起后只剩一行「OpenCode + 本月剩余（没有月度额度时显示总花费）」，再点一下展开。卡片顶部有一条拖拽热区（悬停露出一小条横线），上下拖动直接调卡片限高，拖到内容放满、不再需要滚动时会自动关掉限高。卡片顶部是账户入口：点账户名可切换组织和服务账号，右侧是刷新、设置与收起按钮。
- 今日花费、请求数、tokens； - Tokens 列默认显示紧凑值，悬停或键盘聚焦可看精确到个位的数字； - 有月度额度时，顶部油表显示本月剩余百分比； - 下方并排汇总今日、本周、本月，不用来回切页面。
- 滚动 5 小时、本周、本月三个窗口； - 进度条按四档分级变色，右侧显示已用百分比； - 每行带重置倒计时；没有 Go 订阅时整块隐藏。
- 按当前计费周期的花费速度做线性外推； - 绿色为实测、橙色为预测，标出 50% / 100% 的预计日期； - 没有月度额度或有效数据不足两个点时整块隐藏。
- 7 天 / 24 小时切换； - 花费 / tokens / 请求数切换； - 没有数据时保留分块，显示空态文案。
- 按花费排序，条形长度按最高花费归一化； - 最多显示四行； - 没有按模型计费记录时整块隐藏。

- 每个分块标题右侧有一个箭头，点一下收成一行，再点一下展开； - 收起时标题右侧显示这一块的关键数据： - 用量 → `当日 · $0.55` - 额度重置时间 → `本月 · 23% 已用` - 月度预测 → `11/27 · 163%`（重置日期 + 按当前速度的预测值） - 趋势 → `11/01 · $0.55`（24 小时时是 `18:00 · $0.12`） - 模型 → 只放第一名的模型名 - 卡片窄的时候这些文字会自动省略成 `…`，标题和箭头位置不动； - 最后一个分块的提示气泡朝上弹，不会被卡片底边裁掉。
设置 → OpenCode 套餐。Key 仍在 DSH 的 provider 设置里管理，这一页只读。
- 账户按组织分组，同一组织的 Key 合成一张卡； - 当前账户打绿色「当前」，其余可「切换」；组织下的服务账号可以单独筛选花费； - 「刷新数据」立即重读，刷新间隔可选 30 秒 / 1 分钟 / 5 分钟 / 15 分钟； - Key 只读，改 Key 去 DSH 设置 → Providers（`llm-pi-ai`）。

- 卡片样式：开关控制是否显示左侧色条，旁边选色条颜色； - 卡片限高：默认关闭；打开后分块区最高到设定像素，超出在卡片内滚动（卡片头和账户菜单不会被裁）。上限永远等于「内容自然高度 - 1px」，跟着内容实时变化，输入框只做范围保护；也可以直接拖卡片顶部的把手上下调，拖到顶（已经没有东西可滚）时会自动关掉限高一次； - 进度条分级：四档的名称、区间、颜色都可以改，区间首尾相接； - 「恢复默认」回到 0–50 绿、50–75 黄、75–90 橙、90–100 红。

- 一行一个分块：左边是该块的开关，右边就是它在侧栏里的真实渲染；
- 「在侧栏显示」控制整块；「收起」让这一块在侧栏里只留一行标题（收起时标题右侧显示它的关键数据，见上面的「分块收起」）；用量块另有「本周」「本月」控制表格行，以及「简化版本」——只保留今日，油表缩到左侧、花费 / 请求数 / Tokens 各占一行，块高度从约 230px 降到约 75px；简化版打开时「本周 / 本月」置灰（选择保留）；
- 悬停行标题时右侧浮出拖拽点，按住标题上下拖即可调整顺序；
- 趋势的 7 天 / 24 小时、花费 / tokens / 请求数切换直接在右侧预览里点；24 小时轴会按卡片实际宽度自动抽稀标签；
- 「简化版本」后面的 `?` 是这一项的说明，面板标题旁的 `?` 是操作提示。

> 这里没有单独的「趋势图」设置面板：趋势的显示范围与指标就在卡片展示的预览里切换。

卡片的五个分块由**接口数据**决定，不是配置开关，也不看 provider 名：

| 形态 | 你会看到 |
| --- | --- |
| 只有 Go 订阅 | 五个分块齐全 |
| 只有 Console 按量 | 额度与预测隐藏，保留用量、趋势、模型 |
| Go + Console | 合并成一张卡，与「只有 Go」一致 |

插件用 `GET /inference/go/v1/usage` 的 200/404 判断有没有 Go 订阅，provider id 只决定优先用哪把 Key。完整规则见 [开发与原理 → 账户形态](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/docs/README.md#账户形态)。

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.x（开发环境 `0.2.1-rc.5`；Web profile 同理）；
- 一个 OpenCode Go 订阅，或仅有 Console 用量的 OpenCode 账户；
- 能访问 `opencode.ai`。

readme.section: 从 DSH Market 安装（推荐）
readme.text:
插件已经上架 DSH 插件市场：

1. 打开 DSH → 设置 → **插件**（或插件市场）；
2. 搜索 `dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard`；也可以搜「OpenCode 额度」；
3. 点 **安装**，装完在侧栏就能看到卡片。

市场里的版本号跟随 npm 发布；`1.2.0` 之后的功能（分块收起、统一提示气泡等）需要市场里的版本 ≥ 1.2.0。

> **升级后请点「重启」而不是「刷新页面」**：这个插件在 host 侧注册了 `/api/opencode-quota/*` 路由，属于 host 模块，DSH 无法热替换它；点刷新会报 `import failed`，点重启即可。首次安装同样建议装完重启一次。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

Web 版 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

> `github:` 源需要本机能连 `github.com:443` 的 git 协议。连不上就改用 npm，或指定 tag 的 codeload tarball：
> `dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.2.1`

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

2026-10-30 之前的版本叫 `@local/dsh-opencode-quota`（0.1.0），和现在的包名**不是同一个包**。从旧版本升级必须**先卸载再安装**，否则两份并存、侧栏里仍然是旧卡片：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-opencode-quota
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

装完点「重启」（不是「刷新页面」），见上面的说明。

在仓库根目录运行：

```powershell
npm start
```

这是本地开发用的安装源切换器，按提示选择：

- **1) 本地 link**：把 desktop profile 指回当前仓库，改完代码后重载插件（必要时重启 DSH）；
- **2) GitHub**：安装 GitHub 版，用来验证用户实际拿到的发布包。

脚本固定执行“卸载 → 清理 `node_modules` 里的旧 junction/临时目录 → 安装所选来源”。DSH 卸载 `link:` 安装时不会删除 junction，直接切换会 `EPERM`，所以从 link 切到 GitHub 不要只靠 DSH 的卸载按钮。

运行前不需要退出 DSH：`dsh plugin` 只是把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，安装动作和运行中的 DSH 不冲突。profile 默认带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr`（`root` 为空，只盯 profile manifest 与 patch 文件），profile 一变 DSH 就会重新组合插件；只有它提示「请重启 DSH 使更改生效」（`package-moved`、`host-module` 这类情况）时才需要重启。真被文件占用（`EBUSY` / `EPERM`）时，脚本会提示你先退出 DSH 重跑。`dsh` 命令需要在 PATH 上。默认操作 `desktop` profile；需要指定其他 profile 或代理时：

```powershell
$env:DSH_PROFILE = 'web'
$env:DSH_PROXY = 'http://127.0.0.1:7890'
npm start
```

GitHub 选项需要能访问 github.com；`DSH_PROXY` 不设置时默认使用 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`。

不想用脚本时，也可以手动安装本地 link：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:C:\path\to\dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard"
```

`link:` 直接引用本地目录，改代码后重载插件（必要时重启 DSH），不需要重新安装。

插件读取 DSH 里已有的 `opencode` / `opencode-go` provider 凭据：

1. 打开 DSH 设置 → Providers（`llm-pi-ai`）；
2. 配置 `opencode-go` 和/或 `opencode` 的 API Key；
3. 回到「设置 → OpenCode 套餐」，点「刷新数据」。

Key 也可以走环境变量回退：`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_API_KEY`。插件设置页只读，不会把 Key 下发到浏览器。
```sh

readme.section: GitHub 安装的更新：重新执行 add；没拉到新提交就先 remove 再 add
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard

readme.section: npm 安装的更新（Market 里也可以直接点更新）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard

dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

- Key 只在 DSH Host 进程内使用，不下发到浏览器、不写日志；
- 额度数据不落盘；界面偏好存在浏览器 `localStorage`；
- 所有 Host 路由只接受本机回环请求，并校验 `Origin` / `sec-fetch-site`；
- 上游请求 12 秒超时、拒绝重定向、响应体上限 256 KB。

架构、接口、已知限制、调试与发布检查见 [docs/README.md](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/docs/README.md)。

- 插件代码：MIT，见 [LICENSE](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE)； - 内嵌 Noto Sans SC 字体：SIL OFL 1.1，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 ---
Made for DeepSeek Harness · 数据来自 OpenCode

OpenCode Usage Dashboard

Quota, spend and usage for OpenCode — right in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

Install · UI · Account shapes · Development
简体中文: README.md

> [!NOTE] > This is a third-party plugin for DeepSeek Harness. All data comes from OpenCode's official endpoints.
Sidebar card (light theme, sample data): usage · quota · forecast · trend · models

OpenCode spreads quota, spend and usage across several endpoints: Go subscription windows (rolling / weekly / monthly) and Console spend with token counts. This plugin puts them on one sidebar card, so you don't need the web console or your own spreadsheet.

- **Works for Go and pay-as-you-go accounts**: quota windows when you have a Go subscription, spend/trend/models when you only have Console usage.
- **Know today's cost**: spend, requests and tokens for today, plus week and month totals.
- **See the trend**: 7 days / 24 hours, switchable between spend, tokens and requests.
- **Know before you run out**: with a monthly quota, the current billing-period burn rate is projected and the 50% / 100% dates are labelled.
- **Know which models cost money**: model bars sorted by spend.
- **Multiple accounts, no collisions**: keys of the same org are merged into one card, different orgs stay separate; switch accounts and filter spend by service account.
- **Configurable**: block order and visibility, rail colour, four-tier thresholds, trend metric, refresh interval.
- **Unobtrusive**: follows the DSH theme, Chinese/English UI, no external CDN, preferences stay on your machine.
Below: the five sidebar blocks and the three settings panels. Screenshots use fixed sample data (`acme` / `org_acme` and similar names are fictional); real numbers follow your account.

The card sits above the sidebar settings button. When the sidebar itself is collapsed it reduces to a small percentage/amount tile; expanded, it shows the blocks in your preferred order — only 「Usage」 and 「Quota reset」 are on by default, the rest can be enabled in settings. Every block has an arrow on the right of its title: click it to fold that block into a single row (title plus its key figure — usage shows today's spend, quota shows month-to-date usage, trend shows the latest bucket, models shows the top model), click again to expand. The card header has a collapse button as well; collapsed it becomes one line: "OpenCode + monthly remaining" (or total spend when there is no monthly quota). A drag strip above the card (a thin line appears on hover) resizes the card height; dragging until everything fits turns the height cap off automatically. The card header is also the account switcher: click the account name to change org / service account; refresh, settings and collapse buttons sit on the right.

- three windows: rolling 5 hours, this week, this month; - bar colour follows the four-tier thresholds, the used percentage is on the right; - each row carries a reset countdown; the whole block is hidden without a Go subscription.

- linear projection based on the current billing-period burn rate; - green is measured, orange is projected, with 50% / 100% dates labelled; - hidden without a monthly quota or with fewer than two data points.
- 7 days / 24 hours; - spend / tokens / requests; - keeps the block with an empty-state message when there is no data.
- sorted by spend, bar length normalised to the highest value; - at most four rows; - hidden when there are no per-model billing records.

- the arrow right of each block title folds it into one row and unfolds it again;
- while folded the title shows that block's key figure:
  - usage → `Today · $0.55`
  - quota reset → `This month · 23% used`
  - forecast → `11/27 · 163%` (reset date + projection at the current rate)
  - trend → `11/01 · $0.55` (`18:00 · $0.12` for 24 hours)
  - models → the top model name only
- on narrow cards the text is ellipsised with `…`; titles and arrows stay put;
- the last block's tooltip opens upwards so it is not clipped by the card edge.
Settings → OpenCode plan. API keys stay in DSH's provider settings; this page is read-only.
> There is no separate "trend" settings panel: range and metric are switched right in this preview.

The five blocks are decided by **API data**, not by a config switch and not by the provider name:

| Shape | What you see |
| --- | --- |
| Go subscription only | all five blocks |
| Console pay-as-you-go only | quota and forecast hidden; usage, trend and models remain |
| Go + Console | merged into one card, same as "Go only" |

The plugin treats `GET /inference/go/v1/usage` returning 200 vs 404 as the Go subscription check; the provider id only decides which key is preferred. Full rules in [Development → Account shapes](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/docs/README.md#账户形态).

> **After upgrading click 「Restart」, not 「Refresh page」**: this plugin registers `/api/opencode-quota/*` routes on the host side, which makes it a host module — DSH cannot hot-swap it. Refreshing the page ends with `import failed`; restarting is enough. The same applies to a fresh install.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

> The `github:` source needs the git protocol to `github.com:443`. If that is blocked, use npm, or a tag-pinned codeload tarball:
> `dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.2.1`

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

readme.section: Migrating from the old package name
readme.text:
Before 2026-10-30 the package was called `@local/dsh-opencode-quota` (0.1.0) — a **different package**. Upgrading from it requires an uninstall first, otherwise both copies stay installed and the sidebar keeps showing the old card:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-opencode-quota
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```

Then click 「Restart」 (not 「Refresh page」) — see above.

Run from the repository root:

```powershell
npm start
```

This is a source switcher for local development; it asks which source to install:

- **1) local link**: point the desktop profile back at this repository, reload the plugin after edits (restart DSH if needed);
- **2) GitHub**: install the GitHub build, to verify what users actually get.

The script always runs "uninstall → clean old junctions/temp dirs in `node_modules` → install the chosen source". DSH does not remove the junction when uninstalling a `link:` install, and switching directly would fail with `EPERM`, so don't rely on DSH's uninstall button alone when moving from link to GitHub.

You don't need to quit DSH first: `dsh plugin` just forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory, which does not conflict with a running DSH. Profiles ship `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` (empty `root`, watching only the profile manifest and patch files), so DSH recomposes plugins whenever the profile changes; a restart is only needed when it says "restart DSH for the change to take effect" (`package-moved`, `host-module`, and similar). If files are genuinely locked (`EBUSY` / `EPERM`) the script asks you to quit DSH and rerun. The `dsh` command must be on PATH. The script targets the `desktop` profile by default; to pick another profile or a proxy:

```powershell
$env:DSH_PROFILE = 'web'
$env:DSH_PROXY = 'http://127.0.0.1:7890'
npm start
```

The GitHub option needs access to github.com; when `DSH_PROXY` is unset it defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:7890`.

Without the script you can also install a local link manually:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:C:\path\to\dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard"
```
`link:` references the local directory directly; after editing code reload the plugin (restart DSH if needed) — no reinstall required.
```sh

readme.section: GitHub install: run add again; if no new commit is picked up, remove then add
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard

readme.section: npm install (the Market also offers an update button)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard

dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard
```
Architecture, endpoints, known limitations, debugging and the release checklist live in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/docs/README.md).

- plugin code: MIT, see [LICENSE](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE); - bundled Noto Sans SC font: SIL OFL 1.1, see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/zhxmt-xm/dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ---
Made for DeepSeek Harness · data from OpenCode
